newsitem.title: CANADA: NHL HOCKEY-FLAMES BLANK KINGS, COYOTES NIP DEVILS.
newsitem.headline: NHL HOCKEY-FLAMES BLANK KINGS, COYOTES NIP DEVILS.

text.p: Rookie Dwayne Roloson made 22 saves to earn his first NHL win and Jonas Hoglund and Theoren Fleury scored as the Calgary Flames blanked the Los Angeles Kings, 2-0 on Thursday.

Roloson, who became the Flames' backup goaltender when Rick Tabaracci was traded to Tampa Bay 10 days ago, made two saves in the first period, nine in the second and 11 in the third to post his first NHL shutout in his third career start.
"It's nice to get it all done at once," said Roloson. "I just treated it like any other game. I do not like to put any pressure on myself."
Stephane, Fiset made 27 saves for the Kings, who have been shut out in three of their last five games.
In Phoenix, Keith Tkachuk scored his third goal of the game with 52 seconds left in overtime and the Phoenix Coyotes broke a five-game winless streak with a 4-3 triumph over the New Jersey Devils.

Tkachuk broke into the Devils' zone 1-on-2, but skated wide of defenceman Lyle Odelein into the left faceoff circle. He fired a blast that deflected off Odelein's stick and just inside the right goal post on the only shot in the extra period.
Chad Kilger had the other goal for Phoenix.
Kevin Dean's goal lifted New Jersey into a 3-3 tie midway through the third period, but the Devils had their 22-game overtime unbeaten streak snapped.
New Jersey has lost three of its last four games after winning seven of its previous eight.
